content:
Maya: That all-hands hit different tonight — standing at my desk clapping 👏😂
Jon: same, my cat judged my ukulele but gave a slow blink of approval :guitar: :cat: 
Priya: who brought the energy?? :sparkles: seriously bops.
Sam: @Maya you mentioned snacks in the roadmap demo — when is the snack cabinet restock? :eyes: 
Maya: next Thursday, bulk chips and a fancy hummus trial. opinions welcome.
Lena: hummus trial = my entire agenda. plus pita. :drooling_face:
Theo: I vote caramel popcorn and somehow also pretzels. you can’t lose.
Priya: poll: hummus / popcorn / pretzels — react with :one: :two: :three: 
deploy-bot: Poll created (24h) — hummus / popcorn / pretzels — react to vote 👍
Jon: also shoutout to infra for that CI demo -> :tada: so smooth.
Maya: big kudos to @Sam for the animated slide transitions, gorgeous work :sparkles: :heart_eyes:
Sam: thanks! my transition animations are basically jazz hands in CSS.
Lena: can we get a gif of the ukulele moment? need it for morale archive.
Theo: uploading one I snagged — https://giphy.com/gifs/ukulele-ovation-abc123 (embed: :giphy:)
Priya: lol perfect. I added it to #random for posterity.
All-Hands Bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.cloud/recordings/ah-1749991234.mp4 (1h 2m)
Jon: someone needs to caption the part where the CEO sneezed at 32:10. iconic. :sneezing_face:
Maya: note to self: remember to bring handkerchiefs for next all-hands 😂
Theo: tiny plant parade in the office next week? potted plant salute to product wins :seedling:
Lena: I will bring my succulent and name it "Throughput".
Priya: best plant name contest — winner gets first dibs on hummus trial.
Sam: can we have a micro-kazoo encore in 5? low-fi jam session in #random.
Jon: in. kazoo + ukulele crossover confirmed. :musical_note:
Maya: love this energy. post-any highlights here if you have them, and add reactions for the snack poll! :thumbsup:
